#!/bin/bash
set -eu
tmux -D -f /dev/null &
for i in {1..100}; do test -S "$TMUX_TMPDIR/tmux-$(id -u)/default" && break; sleep .1; done
tmux set-option -g default-shell /bin/bash
tmux new-session -d -s taurhaus -x 140 -y 48 /bin/bash
/tmp/th-l2-6_217q4o/home/.local/bin/taurhaus-daemon --port 45321 --data-dir /tmp/th-l2-6_217q4o/data &
wait $!

agents.name: alpha
agents.instructions: Reply briefly. When a message assigns you a task, run exactly the mesh lifecycle commands the message names, in order, then reply with the task id and the word done. Never modify files. For ACTION REQUIRED marker messages, read your inbox with mesh read --json --mark-read --claude-dir "$CLAUDE_DIR" --team l2-busy --name alpha and reply exactly with the requested marker. Follow every returned cursor until done. Do not send other messages.
